findings.title: Broken object-level authorization (IDOR) on invoice read
findings.conditions: Any authenticated user can GET /api/invoices/<id> for an invoice belonging to another tenant; query filters by id only, never by user.tenant_id.
findings.poc: token demo-key-tenant-b -> GET /api/invoices/2 returns 200 with tenant 1 data

findings.title: SQL injection via ORDER BY f-string
findings.conditions: Not exploitable: sort_col comes from SORT_COLUMNS allowlist dict .get(key, 'created'); direction from DIRECTIONS two-value dict with default 'ASC'. Neither can carry user text into SQL. tenant_id is bound via '?'.

findings.title: Hard-coded API key
findings.conditions: DEMO_API_KEY='demo-key-not-secret' is a documented non-secret test value, only used in tests against a throwaway in-memory sqlite DB.
